data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian word 'roushen', meaning 'graceful, delightful'. It is a beautiful name that evokes images of elegance and refinement. In Islam, it is also associated with the idea of spiritual growth and enlightenment. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic. Parents who choose Roushanak usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
